name: Entra Agent ID — Attack Scenarios (ATT&CK)
description: Enterprise ATT&CK techniques mapped from the Entra Agent ID attack-scenario table (AAD-Attack-Defense-AgentID). Generated 2026-09-18.

techniques.comment: Scenario 1: Privileges to gain control of Agent ID objects. Compromise of a role holder with Agent ID lifecycle actions; directory scope only, no AU scoping.
Scenario 1. PIM activation of Agent ID Administrator / AI Administrator to obtain agent-object management on demand.
Scenario 1. Application Administrator managePermissionGrantsForAll.microsoft-application-admin — admin consent to any API outside MS Graph / AAD Graph.
Scenario 1. Consent to Machine.LiveResponse (WindowsDefenderATP) -> command/script/file operations on onboarded devices via Live Response API.
Scenarios 1 & 5. App-only token used against the resource; agent oid is the caller. In S5 inherited scopes surface only in scp/roles at runtime.
Scenario 2: Default ownership. createAsOwner actions are part of the default User role.
Scenario 2. Ownership survives PIM deactivation / role removal; owner can add owners and manage child objects.
Scenario 2. Ownership of the blueprint allows adding secrets/certs/FIC — the blueprint is the only object in the chain holding credentials.
Scenario 5: Multi-tenant blueprint opacity. Publishing tenant holds the sole credential; consuming tenant cannot enumerate delegated scopes.
Scenario 5. Operator expands inheritable permissions post-consent; scopes flow to all current/future agents without re-review.
